data.name: 水浒女神录
data.detailed_description:
This is no longer the fixed story you remember. At the end of the Northern Song Dynasty, the way of heaven changed, and you came as an "alien star" with magical power that resonated with the hero's soul. Every word you say will directly touch the hearts of Liangshan heroes through advanced AI technology, awaken their sleeping power of the stars, and even change the trajectory of their fate. Is it to join hands with Song Jiang to build an ideal country, or to support Wu Song to achieve a generation of killing gods? The choice is in your mouth.

The fate of the dynasty is completely subverted in your words and deeds!

Specific gameplay:

Subversive main plot: The traditional Water Margin story has been completely rewritten. Your choices will determine the final outcome.

108 unique interactable characters: Each goddess corresponds to the Tiangang Earth Constellation, with independent life backgrounds, personality preferences and exclusive plot lines. For example:

Lin Chong (Tian Xiongxing): Originally the coach of the Forbidden Army, he embarked on the road of revenge after being framed.

AI-Enhanced Dialogue System: Conversations with characters are not simply chosen but are conducted through an intelligent dialogue system. Each of your responses will dynamically affect the character's favorability and trust in you, and trigger different subsequent plots and character feedback. Have an intelligent conversation with every goddess through the chat box.

Equipment System and Skill System: Peak friendship or loyalty through chatting, and the hero will break through the mortal body and awaken as the true "Heavenly Evil Star"! Lu Zhishen can incarnate as the "Crazy Zen Ming King" and pull mountains and rivers; Gongsun Sheng can call the wind and rain and induce the thunder of the nine heavens. Each hero has a unique ultimate form and superpowers.

Short-term goal: Complete the first awakening.

Mid-Term Objective: Complete the key personal story of the majority goddess and defeat strong opponents on the battlefield.

Long-term/ultimate goal: Through your chat, key decisions will affect the moral direction, strategic goals, and multiple completely different game endings of each hero, as well as the entire Yangshan. Get ready, awaken heroes with your words, conquer the world with your army, and create the future with your blood!
